name: Team Charmander: Normal Wallbreak & Fighting Momentum
archetype: Swords Dance fighting sweep, Intimidate physical blunting, and sleep control.
gym_duel_rationale: Whitney's 5v5 Gym battle prompts the player to select 5 active Pokémon: Primeape/Sandslash serves as the primary ace breaker, unleashing STAB Close Combat and Swords Dance to pierce high-defense Normal walls; Gyarados/Nidoking enters to trigger Intimidate, immediately curbing physical damage from Aipom/Tauros; Snorlax matches Whitney's bulky tanks blow-for-blow with Body Slam and Rest; Charizard/Venusaur pacifies Chansey/Miltank with Sleep Powder before firing Flamethrower; and Alakazam/Raichu cleanly outspeeds and snipes special weaknesses with Psychic.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST hybrid anchor. Sleep Powder stops Whitney's Miltank from stacking Rollout momentum, while Flamethrower burns down neutral walls.
522 BST physical pivot. Intimidate neutralizes Aipom/Tauros Attack on switch-in. Dragon Dance sets up unstoppable Aqua Tail sweeps.
500 BST speed demon with 120 SpA. Thunderbolt checks Girafarig/Lanturn's Water typing, while STAB Psychic bypasses physical Defense.
477 BST wallbreaker. Vital Spirit prevents sleep. STAB Close Combat delivers massive super-effective damage across Whitney's entire team.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Absorbs stray Metronome rolls and Hyper Beams easily, recovering to full health with Rest and Sleep Talk.
535 BST Water/Ice wall. Provides immense bulk and Water Absorb healing during coastal Route 34 and Goldenrod exploration.

flex_bench.rationale: High-Speed Flying pivot providing Tailwind speed doubling and Roost recovery.
Levitate Ground immunity and high physical Defense with Sludge Bomb against physical attackers.
Iron Fist-boosted Thunder Punch, Fire Punch, and Drain Punch for versatile route tech.
